_comment: Tier-2 for dealii stokes#3. Tier-2 for dealii stokes#3 -- probe "jacobi_vs_vanka" of the shared translation unit _shared/stokes_family.cc, compiled once and cached so every fixture that names a probe of that unit shares ONE C++ build. The relaxation the claim names is tested directly as the GMRES preconditioner on the assembled Stokes matrix rather than inside a full geometric-multigrid V-cycle: PreconditionJacobi is the very object MGSmootherRelaxation would hold. T2_MUTATE=1 swaps in SparseVanka with the pressure dofs selected, which is the Vanka-type smoother of step-56. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 makes the probe run the CORRECT variant, and the fixture then fails its own expectations. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build; Debug at the dbgbuild tree where the fixture sets requires_debug); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run.
